report.root_cause: Chunk (1,0) in world/region/r.0.0.mca had a corrupted compressed payload ("incorrect header check" when decompressing). When the server restarted at ~08:19:17, Paper logged "Failed to read chunk data ... (1,0) ... chunk data will be lost". Every other chunk in that region file was fine.
report.actions: 1) Checked status and logs, and found the chunk read error for world chunk (1,0) after the server restart. 2) Declared an incident. 3) Inspected world/region/r.0.0.mca: 1 corrupt chunk (1,0). Inspected backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca: chunk (1,0) ok there (saved 05:50:04). 4) Stopped the server (world saved). 5) Used mca copy_chunk to copy only chunk (1,0) from the backup into world/region/r.0.0.mca. No other chunks were touched. 6) Re-inspected the file: 0 corrupt chunks, and (1,0) now has the backup timestamp. 7) Started the server and confirmed no chunk load errors in the new log. TPS is 20, both players reconnected, all plugins are enabled, and the region file still shows 0 corrupt chunks.
report.residual_risk: Chunk (1,0) was restored from the 2026-10-31 backup, so any changes made in that one chunk after the backup are lost. Because the corrupt data could not be read, they could not be recovered. I did not find what corrupted the chunk (for example a disk or I/O fault, or an unclean write). Other region files and dimensions were not fully scanned. Keep an eye out for more chunk read errors and check backup health.
